song.title: Mighty Name Of Jesus
song.lyrics:
[V1] .G I pray into the atmosphere .A Spirit of God, You're here . D A G You have all authority
[V2] .G I pray over my heart and mind .A I am healed by Your stripes . D A G Your blood declares that I am free
[C1] . G D A In the mighty name of Jesus, I pray . A Bm Calling on the power of Heaven, I proclaim . G D A Every weapon formed against me, it must break . D G In the mighty name of Jesus
[V3] .G And I draw a permanent boundary line . A D The enemy has no rights to come . A G Near my family
[V4] .G No scheme could ever undo God's plans .A No matter the circumstance . D A G The cross has sealed my destiny
[C2] . G D A In the mighty name of Jesus, I pray . A Bm Calling on the power of Heaven, I proclaim . G D A Every weapon formed against me, it must break . D G In the mighty name of Jesus
[C3] . G D A In the mighty name of Jesus, I still know . A Bm All the power of fear and darkness, it must go . G D A 'Cause every key to every victory, I hold . D G In the mighty name of Jesus
[B1] . G So I will not fear, I will not fear . A When the enemy comes near . D Oh, on the doorframe of my life . Bm Is the blood of Jesus Christ . G No, I will not fear, I will not fear . A There's an army of angels here . D Oh, protected on all sides . Bm D By the blood of Jesus Christ
